It is exclusively made from the whey of Sicilo- Sarda sheep 's milk. [17] Rigouta is also used as the basis of several preparations and dishes of Tunisian cuisine . In Spanish, ricotta is known as requesón . It can be salted or sweetened for cooking purposes. It was brought to Mexico by the Spaniards, although it is not as commonly used as queso fresco . It is sometimes used as filling for tlacoyos and tacos dorados , and in the central west area ( Jalisco , Michoacán , and Colima ) it is spread over tostadas or bolillos , or served as a side to beans.
